name: workwear-edit
description: Check dress codes and plan a work week.

interface.longDescription: Check dress codes and plan a work week. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Compare garments to a dress code; Schedule supplied work outfits; Compare purchase and alteration costs. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare garments to a dress code.
Help me schedule supplied work outfits.

prompts: Help me compare garments to a dress code.
Help me schedule supplied work outfits.
Help me compare purchase and alteration costs.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Workday Wardrobe workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Compare garments to a dress code. Reproducible inputs: {"required_tags":["collared"],"prohibited_tags":["distressed"],"items":[{"name":"Oxford shirt","category":"top","price":60,"tags":["collared","neutral"]},{"name":"Trousers","category":"bottom","price":80,"tags":["tailored","neutral"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare garments to a dress code with these supplied values: {"required_tags":["collared"],"prohibited_tags":["distressed"],"items":[{"name":"Oxford shirt","category":"top","price":60,"tags":["collared","neutral"]},{"name":"Trousers","category":"bottom","price":80,"tags":["tailored","neutral"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses workwear_edit_dress_code_check with the supplied inputs. Returns {"items":[{"name":"Oxford shirt","category":"top","price":60,"tags":["collared","neutral"],"required_missing":[],"prohibited_found":[]},{"name":"Trousers","category":"bottom","price":80,"tags":["tailored","neutral"],"required_missing":["collared"],"prohibited_found":[]}],"note":"Checks user-entered tags; employer policy remains authoritative."}. Shows the actual checklist result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Schedule supplied work outfits. Reproducible inputs: {"days":["Mon","Tue","Wed"],"dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium","outfits":[{"name":"Navy set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"},{"name":"Grey set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me schedule supplied work outfits with these supplied values: {"days":["Mon","Tue","Wed"],"dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium","outfits":[{"name":"Navy set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"},{"name":"Grey set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses workwear_edit_workweek_outfits with the supplied inputs. Returns {"week":[{"day":"Mon","name":"Navy set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"},{"day":"Tue","name":"Grey set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"},{"day":"Wed","name":"Navy set","dress_code":"business casual","warmth":"medium"}],"distinct_outfits":2,"repeats_needed":true}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.
